name: Air
description: v1's quark-model air: a 13×13 lattice of atoms by abundance (143 N, 25 O, 1 Ar); each atom is 3Z up + 3Z down quarks and Z electrons, bound by v1's powAXv3 nuclear force (pull below 0.22 of the 3 fm range) and Coulomb; about 1% of nuclei carry negative nuclear charge as in v1. Gravity (G ≈ 7e-39) is negligible and omitted.

forces.name: Nuclear (v1 powAXv3)
forces.expression: -k * n_i * n_j * sin(A * (1 - B^x)) * a * exp(-a * x)
